subject: Tony Blair
findings: The page reproduces 67 for Saptavargaja. Raising Mercury's D2 score from 15 to 20 gives 72 with the other six divisions unchanged.
Several existing hora options produce 72 for this chart; it does not uniquely identify Star Jyotish's general rule.
The page classifies Mercury as benefic and gives Paksha 31.294226276489024. The malefic complement is 28.705773723510976, rounding to 29.
Mercury and Sun share Aries about 18.987 degrees apart. A same-sign solar association rule could explain the classification, but this is an inference, not a verified Star Jyotish rule.
